evals.name: morning-run
evals.prompt: Did this morning's collection run OK? Anything I should worry about before the BD meeting?
evals.expected_output: Runs health_check.py, answers first in plain language, gives last successful run and next scheduled run, mentions expected IMAP warning without alarm, no table of green ticks.
expectations: The report's first line answers whether this morning's collection worked
Gives the time of the last successful collection and the next scheduled run
Treats 'IMAP not configured' as expected, not as a failure
Made no changes (no collection, reclassify, file edits or task changes)

evals.name: no-new-leads
evals.prompt: No new leads in the dashboard today - is something broken?
evals.expected_output: Runs the report, distinguishes 'nothing new published' from a failure using run logs (read vs kept counts), explains with evidence, proposes fixes only if something is wrong.
expectations: Uses run figures (items read vs leads kept/new, last fetch times) to tell 'nothing new published' apart from a failure
States a clear conclusion with evidence (log line, timestamps or counts)
Proposes a fix only if something is actually wrong
Made no changes (no collection, reclassify, file edits or task changes)
